features.title: Features
features.noAuthDesc: No email, no password, no account. Just enter your display name and start collaborating. Perfect for shared lists where not everyone wants to create an account.
features.realtimeDesc: Online changes are refreshed about every three seconds so the group can follow progress.
features.shareDesc: Each list has a unique URL. Share it via text, email, WhatsApp, or any messaging app. Anyone with the link can join.
features.assignDesc: Add participants by name and assign specific items to them. See at a glance who is responsible for what on your shared list.
features.mobileDesc: Works on any phone, tablet, or computer. No app download required — runs entirely in your web browser.
features.freeDesc: Create and share lists for free. No account or app download required.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I create a shared list?
faq.a1: Choose Create New List, name it and add participants. Share the resulting link so others can open the list and choose their display name.
faq.a2: Anyone holding a list link or ID can read and modify that list. Display names are not authentication. Share list access only with people and agents you trust; avoid sensitive information.
faq.q3: Can I assign items to people?
faq.a3: Yes. Add participants by name and assign an item to one or more people. Everyone with access can change assignments.
faq.a4: Yes. Use a modern browser on your phone, tablet or computer. No app download is required.
faq.a5: Yes. You can create and share lists for free without an account.
faq.q6: Can an AI agent edit the same list as people?
faq.a6: Yes. Connect a compatible MCP client using legacy HTTP/SSE. An agent can create and read lists, rename lists and items, add and describe items, assign them, and mark them complete or incomplete.
faq.q7: Which MCP transport should I use?
faq.a7: Choose legacy HTTP/SSE transport and use https://togetherlist.eu/api/v1/mcp/sse. Keep the SSE connection open and POST messages to the session endpoint it advertises. No API key is required. For custom integrations, POST JSON-RPC 2.0 to https://togetherlist.eu/api/v1/mcp with Content-Type: application/json. This direct POST endpoint is not Streamable HTTP. Clients that only support Streamable HTTP cannot connect using that transport.
faq.q8: Can an agent discover all lists?
faq.a8: No. There is no global list enumeration. To read or modify an existing list, supply its ID. The list://{listId} resource also requires a known list ID.

mcp.title: Let an agent plan. Let people take it from there.
mcp.intro: TogetherList supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so a compatible AI client can work on the same shared list as your group.
mcp.workflowTitle: From meal plan to shared groceries
mcp.step1: Ask your connected agent to create a grocery list with Alex and Sam as participants, then add ingredients and quantities in item descriptions.
mcp.step2: Open the returned list ID at /list/{listId} and share that link with your group. People can review the plan and change assignments in the browser.
mcp.step3: As people shop and check off items, ask the agent to read the list again before suggesting changes. Agent writes change the shared list directly.
mcp.capabilities: Available tools: create_list, get_list, rename_list, add_item, complete_item (complete or reopen), assign_item, update_item_title and update_item_description. Read a known list as the resource list://{listId}. There is no global list enumeration.
mcp.setup: Choose legacy HTTP/SSE transport and use https://togetherlist.eu/api/v1/mcp/sse. Keep the SSE connection open and POST messages to the session endpoint it advertises. No API key is required.
mcp.transport: For custom integrations, POST JSON-RPC 2.0 to https://togetherlist.eu/api/v1/mcp with Content-Type: application/json. This direct POST endpoint is not Streamable HTTP. Clients that only support Streamable HTTP cannot connect using that transport.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.disclosure: With your permission, we use Microsoft Clarity to collect website usage data to improve TogetherList.
privacy.statement: Optional Microsoft Clarity collects behavioral metrics, heatmaps and session replay using first-party and third-party cookies and tracking technologies for product improvement and usability. Advertising storage is denied; Microsoft Advertising is not integrated. Recording is restricted to clean landing pages without saved lists; list creation, private lists and privacy pages are excluded. You can accept, decline or revoke below. Declining prevents loading Clarity.
privacy.localData: List names, items and participant names are stored by our server in JSONL files. Your browser stores per-list identity, saved lists and offline edits. Shared list links grant access: keep them private. Analytics choices are stored locally in this browser.
privacy.accepted: Analytics: allowed on eligible landing pages.
privacy.storageError: Your choice could not be saved. Analytics stays off after a failed acceptance. Please check browser storage settings.
